caseName: Ad Hoc Committee of Kenton County Bondholders v. Delta Air Lines, Inc.
caseNameFull: AD HOC COMMITTEE OF KENTON COUNTY BONDHOLDERS v. DELTA AIR LINES, INC.

opinions.text:
Motion of Professor George W. Kuney for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.

Justice SOTOMAYOR took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this petition.
